stations.title: Fill 1L cloudy juice
stations.does: Fill each 1L bottle with cloudy apple juice through a nozzle (about 6 seconds per bottle filling).
steps: open fill valve and dispense cloudy apple juice

stations.title: Screw red cap
stations.does: Screw on the red cap to the filled bottle.
steps: confirm bottle is filled and positioned
feed a red cap to the capper spindle
confirm cap presence/torque OK for next step

stations.title: Apply paper label
stations.does: Apply the paper label to the capped bottle.
steps: verify cap present/position for label alignment (via vision trigger gate)
dispense label from web/stack into tamp pad
tamp label onto bottle body (front side aligned)
hold for set time to ensure adhesion
retract pad and release bottle to next station

stations.title: Vision inspection + reject
stations.does: Use a camera to check fill level, cap presence/quality, and label presence/placement; reject bad bottles off the line.
steps: capture image(s) of cap presence/seat quality
if FAIL: actuate side pusher/diverter to move bottle to discard position
if PASS: keep bottle on main belt to exit

notes: Takt is 15 s per unit (240/h). Fill is explicitly budgeted at ~6 s; Cap/Label/Inspect are budgeted to remain ≤15 s each, so the overall line runs on the slowest station. If the owner’s real capping, labeling dwell, or vision cycle time exceeds 15 s, the line rate must be reduced or operations parallelized.
Reject is implemented as a diversion off the main flow; no rework is included (matches the discard-only requirement).
Food-grade handling and stainless frames are assumed for the equipment cell; builder should ensure wetted parts and guarding meet food regulations.
